exposure: isolated idiopathic congenital talipes equino varus (ICTEV)
Isolated idiopathic congenital talipes equino varus (ICTEV)
Ethnicity: New Zealand Europeans vs. Maori vs. other Polynesians
cohort: 163 children with ICTEV at birth who attended a regional talipes clinic
finding: The rate of additional abnormalities in children with ICTEV was higher than previously reported (30.1% overall), with a higher rate in New Zealand Europeans (43%) compared to Maori (21%) and other Polynesians (22%).
